A page, freshly made
a red pin lands on the chart
the agent wakes up

Version two arrives
the comments you left last night
now marked as addressed

Localhost at dusk
seventy-four eighty hums
no cloud overhead

Drag a quiet square
circle what bothers you most
and say what you see

Comments pile like leaves
check each one, then send them all
the agent rakes them

The page cannot fake
the press of your own finger
the shell knows your touch

Working, says the dot
a small green breath in the bar
someone is building

Brown ink, pink margin
green for go, red for the pin
the palette of care

Stop hook at the end
one more comment slipped in late
the work carries on

Old name in the dust
the rename settled in now
same light, shorter word
